modules.comment: IMPORT-ORDER RULE: the CANONICAL module for a shared input sheet must be listed FIRST. ManureManagement_Swine and Enteric_Swine both ship 'Input - Swine'; ManureManagement is assumed canonical (full input set) here - confirm before building.
Duplicate of the shared input sheet: imported AFTER the canonical ManureManagement_Swine and renamed via renameSheets so it does not collide.
Fertiliser constants required for manure sent off site calcs

Per the Chapter 2 doc's Swine MODULE MAP TABLE (authoritative - not the prose 'additional guidance' sentence, which is incomplete/misleading, e.g. it omits Fuel entirely even though Fuel is genuinely in the table): relevant Scope 3 rows are 15.1 Purchased Livestock, 15.2 Purchased Feed, 15.7 Purchased Services/Contractors, 15.10 Other Purchased Goods and Services, 15.11 Upstream Emission from Fuel, 15.12 Upstream Emissions of Purchased Electricity, 15.13 Management of Waste. The '15 Scope 3' calc sheet carries all Scope3 sub-sections with no per-row subsetting available, so irrelevant rows (15.3 mineral supplements, 15.4 fertiliser components, 15.5 agrichemicals, 15.6 lime, 15.8 packaging, 15.9 grow media, 15.14 freight - NOT in the swine table) will still show up when listing/pasting results; pick only the relevant rows by hand. OPEN QUESTION: 'Input - Freight' is kept below since freight-adjacent quantities may still feed other included rows, but the table does not list a distinct Freight module (15.14) for swine the way it does for Dairy/PastureBeef - worth confirming whether it's actually needed before building.

menu.comment: The column-A navigation menu is regenerated on every sheet from the final sheet set. Groups are assigned automatically: Home/Results = untitled; any sheet named 'Input*' = INPUTS; calculation sheets = CALCULATIONS; everything else = APPENDICES. 'labels' overrides the link text for a sheet (default derivation strips the 'Input - ' prefix, otherwise uses the sheet name). Set enabled=false to leave existing menus untouched.
